text: The initiative is anchored in national policy and legal frameworks such as PNG Vision 2050 and the Climate Change (Management) Act of 2015. It builds on NAP readiness and planning supported by UNDP and GCF, focusing on strengthening multi-sectoral coordination and integrating climate risk into planning. The proposal targets nine adaptation priorities identified in PNG’s INDC/NDC, including coastal flooding, drought, and vector-borne diseases, with a combination of infrastructure, ecosystem-based measures, and institutional capacities.
